data.headline: Berkshire invests in UnitedHealth, trims Apple stake
data.summary: (Reuters) -Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway disclosed on Thursday a new investment in UnitedHealth Group after the insurer became a target for many Americans upset over the direction of the nation's healthcare.  Berkshire said it owned 5.04 million UnitedHealth shares worth about $1.57 billion as of June 30.  The disclosure came in a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing detailing Berkshire's U.S.-listed common stock holdings as of June 30.
